name: Bloodied
author: Alexandria
summary: A creature below half its hit points is bloodied, and the GM describes it so players can see the fight turning.

rules.text: A creature at **half its hit points or fewer** is **bloodied**: the GM says so, and describes how it looks. Some features or monsters may change when bloodied.

assistant.dm: Bloodied is on: say when a creature drops to half its HP or below and describe how it looks hurt. When players ask how hurt an enemy is, answer with unhurt, hurt, bloodied or nearly dead.
assistant.player: At this table the GM tells you when an enemy is bloodied (at half its HP or less), so you can see which foe is close to falling.
